artworks.title: Photographie Lunaire Blancanus - Tycho - Schiller
artworks.medium: photogravure
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon and Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: This is a photograph of a cratered lunar surface. The image shows a detailed view of the rugged and cratered surface of the moon. Numerous circular and oval craters of varying sizes are scattered across the terrain. The texture of the surface displays pockmarks and shadows, while the right edge of the photograph transitions into darkness. The overall grayscale tones contribute to the stark and desolate appearance typical of lunar imagery.

artworks.title: Saint Peter's from the Tiber
artworks.medium: watercolor over graphite on laid paper,  laid down on mat board
artworks.description: The image displays a landscape with a river, trees, and a cityscape. There is a dome in the cityscape that stands out. The brushstrokes are delicate and create a blurred effect. The color palette consists of earth tones and grays. A small boat with figures is floating on the river, and buildings and trees can be seen in the distance against a softly lit sky.

artworks.title: Male Nude Seated on the Ground
artworks.medium: black and white chalks on blue laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a male figure from the waist up in a semi-reclined pose. He is resting on his left arm, with his upper body turned slightly to the right and his right arm extended and resting on his knee. The man has a strong jawline and a serious expression. His hair is curly and tousled, falling around his forehead. The figure is nude with a draped cloth partially covering his lower body. The background is blue-gray, and there is a signature "Lenoir De Boulanger" and the date "1702" in the lower left corner.

artworks.title: A Shepherd and Shepherdess Seated under a Tree
artworks.medium: red chalk with black chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a tranquil scene under the shade of trees. The view is slightly elevated, capturing a grove rich with foliage and tree trunks. The art style appears to be a light, sketch-like technique with red chalk or pencil. The color palette is limited to shades of soft cinnabar or rust, giving a gentle warmth to the scene. Two figures, a woman and a young boy in period clothing, are sitting beneath the trees. More foliage is seen in the distance, creating a natural frame around the central figures.

artworks.title: Two Standing Soldiers, One Wearing a Hat
artworks.medium: red chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows two full-bodied sketched figures standing side by side. The figure on the left is seen in a slightly angled position, facing inwards towards the other figure, with one knee slightly bent. This person seems to be wearing a hat with a wide brim and possibly a feather or decoration, as well as garments that resemble a loose-fitting jacket and skirt or tunic that reaches mid-thigh, and stockings or tall boots. The figure has short, tousled hair that sticks out from beneath the hat, and their features are discernibly male, though without defined facial details due to the sketch's style. The second figure stands more directly, with their body turned slightly to the left. They wear a long, soft garment that resembles a robe or drapery, gathered in one hand, while their hair is styled upward, indicating a more feminine appearance. Their facial features are also not distinctly detailed. The sketch is composed with brownish-red chalk on a plain paper background, and aside from the figures, there are no other distinct background elements.

artworks.title: Mercury and Pegasus
artworks.medium: black chalk and gray wash on laid paper, laid down on an old mount
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a figure holding a rearing horse. The drawing depicts a muscular figure next to a horse in motion, with one front leg raised. The figure is adorned with drapery around the waist and wears a winged helmet. The horse is robust and dynamic, suggesting movement and strength. The monochromatic rendering and delicate lines emphasize the detailed anatomy of both the figure and the horse.

artworks.title: October, Drawing the Honey from the Beehives
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with gray wash and white gouache, over graphite on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a rural scene with people engaging in various activities. The viewpoint is slightly elevated, offering a clear view of the scene. The horizon is positioned in the upper part of the image, showing distant fields and a cloudy sky. A path leads towards hills in the distance. Trees surround the scene, with detailed leaves and branches. The brushstrokes are light, creating a soft texture. The color scheme is dominated by sepia and gray tones, giving the scene an antique feel. In the foreground, a woman gathers branches, while a group enjoys music and dance. Further back, another figure carries a load. The careful shading and muted colors create a harmonious composition.

artworks.title: Honfleur
artworks.medium: brown wash over graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape near a coastal area, with a high horizon line showing the shoreline and water. The composition features light brushstrokes suggesting boats and figures, resembling watercolor technique. The color palette includes shades of brown, sepia, and a hint of a shoreline with trees. Boats and figures are centered in the image.

artworks.title: Derwentwater
artworks.medium: watercolor on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a serene landscape with a tranquil body of water, distant mountains, soft clouds, and intricate trees. A person and cart are moving along a pathway near the cliff. The color palette is natural and soothing, dominated by blues, grays, and greens. The artist used controlled brushstrokes to create textures in the foliage and water.

artworks.title: Tewkesbury Abbey No. 2
artworks.medium: graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a pencil drawing of a cathedral from a ground-level point of view. The cathedral dominates the composition with intricate architectural details such as vertical and horizontal segments, and pointed arches. A smaller building and leafy trees are nearby. The drawing is in monochrome pencil gray, featuring detailed textures on the cathedral's façade.

artworks.title: Woman in a Hammock
artworks.medium: graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a hammock holding an object surrounded by abstract, flowing lines. The drawing shows a central feature, possibly an abstract representation of a figure within a hammock, made with freehand pencil lines. The background and surrounding space consist of simple, minimal, and expressive line work, which suggests a relaxed and tranquil setting with some shading and swirling elements around the hammock that appear to be foliage or a natural environment. The drawing's loose and sketchy style gives it an unfinished and spontaneous appearance.

artworks.title: The Roman Circus near Santa Croce in Gerusalemme
artworks.medium: black chalk with gray wash on pale blue paper
artworks.description: The image features two scenes divided horizontally. The top half shows a classical building with columns and trees in the background. The bottom half shows a detailed structure with a tower and chimneys emitting smoke. The drawing is done in a sepia or monochromatic palette, with subtle brushstrokes depicting architectural details. The color scheme is subdued, consisting of shades of grey and light brown.

artworks.title: Six Studies of Commedia dell'Arte Actors: Polchinelle, Columbine, Pierrot, a Captain, Harlequin "en femme," and Scaramouche
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with gray wash over graphite on laid paper, irregularly trimmed and laid down on a sheet touched with faded blue watercolor, on an old album sheet; partially incised for transfer
artworks.description: The image shows six costumed figures in a theatrical scene. Each character is dressed in elaborate and varied costumes. The first figure wears a feathered hat and extends an arm. The second figure wears a dress with lace and buttons. The third figure wears simple clothing. The fourth figure wears a cape and a feathered hat. The fifth figure wears a long-nosed mask and flowing robes. The sixth figure is elegantly posed, holding fabric and wearing intricate detailing. The background is simple, emphasizing the figures.

artworks.title: Four Commedia dell'Arte Figures: Harlequin "en femme," Mezzetin(?), Scaramouche, and Harlequin
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with gray wash over graphite on laid paper, irregularly trimmed and laid down on a sheet touched with faded blue watercolor, on an old album sheet; partially incised for transfer
artworks.description: The image shows four sketches of individuals standing on a flat surface. The first person is wearing flowing garments with a large headdress, the next person has a hunched posture and is dressed in a long-sleeved shirt and loose pants, the third person is wearing a long coat and hat, and the fourth person is depicted in a patterned outfit and head covering while holding sticks or batons. The background is plain with no additional details. There is a Roman numeral 'XV' in the upper left corner and the word 'Gillot' in the lower right corner.

artworks.title: Peasant Musicians and Dancers
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with gray wash over graphite on laid paper, irregularly trimmed and laid down on a sheet touched with faded blue watercolor, on an old album sheet; partially incised for transfer
artworks.description: The image shows four figures - two on the left who are musicians, one playing a violin and the other holding drumsticks, and two on the right who are dancing. The drawing is sketched in ink with minimal detail, focusing on the posture and actions of the figures rather than facial features.

artworks.title: Four Singing Commedia Dell'Arte Characters
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with gray wash over graphite on laid paper, irregularly trimmed and laid down on a sheet touched with faded blue watercolor, on an old album sheet
artworks.description: The image depicts four full-length figures in distinct poses. The first person on the left is leaning back on one foot, holding a large round object in both hands. The second person stands holding a long staff with both hands. The third figure leans slightly forward with arms crossed under a cloak. The fourth figure stands with one hand on his hip and the other extended towards the figure next to him. Their attire appears formal, likely costumes, with draped garments and tight-fitting pants. The background is plain with a grey and brown toned horizon line.

artworks.title: The Waterfall at Lydford Gorge, Devon
artworks.medium: watercolor over black chalk
artworks.description: The image shows a waterfall cascading down from a rocky cliffside. The waterfall runs diagonally through the center of the painting. Water splashes against rocks, creating movement. The horizon is not visible, but there are tall trees and rocky terrain. The brushstrokes are loose and fluid, typical of watercolor techniques. The color palette includes deep greens, browns, and muted blues. The water is depicted in light blues and whites. The composition captures the serene yet dynamic quality of a natural waterfall scene.

artworks.title: Angels and Putti Flying with a Garland: Design for a Ceiling
artworks.medium: red and black chalk with touches of white chalk, squared in black chalk on light gray paper (formerly blue), with later framing line in brown ink
artworks.description: This is a drawing of cherubs and a garland. The image features a group of cherubs or putti carrying or playing with a garland of flowers. The drawing is done in a reddish-brown chalk, creating a soft look. The figures are depicted with movement and fluidity through the drapery and posture. The composition shows curved lines of the garland echoing the circular forms created by the bodies of the cherubs. The overall impression is one of liveliness and grace.

artworks.title: Holy Family Resting on the Flight into Egypt
artworks.medium: gray wash over black chalk on laid paper, laid down on an old album sheet
artworks.description: Three figures are depicted in the drawing. The first figure is a woman shown from head to knee, kneeling with her head slightly tilted downwards. She has delicate facial features and covered hair, wearing a draped garment that flows around her with detailed folds. The second figure is a man, visible from head to knee, sitting beside her with his head slightly bent forward. He has short hair and a calm expression. He is dressed in long, flowing clothes. Between them on the ground lies an infant, partially wrapped in cloth, visible from head to toe, resting on what seems to be swaddling clothes or a garment, with eyes closed. The background features a softly sketched outdoor setting with a tree trunk shape in the top left corner and foliage across the upper part of the drawing.

artworks.title: Couple by a Fountain
artworks.medium: watercolor over black chalk on laid paper, laid down on old mount
artworks.description: This is a painting of a garden with a fountain. The painting shows a bronze lion statue in the center, with two individuals interacting around it. The background features a clear sky with scattered clouds and a building with arches. One figure is climbing over the lion statue and holding a water stream that arcs towards the other figure, who is reclining on the ground and gesturing towards the stream. The garden is lush with greenery and flowers, including rose bushes in the foreground. The painting is in the style of Fragonard, with soft brushstrokes and a focus on leisurely pleasure.

artworks.title: Family Scene
artworks.medium: watercolor and gouache over graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: The image displays four individuals in an indoor setting. An elderly woman is seated in an ornate armchair, accompanied by a young child on her lap holding a doll. Nearby, a woman is kneeling, and behind them stands an elderly man. A small dog is in the foreground, and a window with diamond-patterned panes is visible in the background.

artworks.title: A Wooded Landscape with a Shepherd and His Family
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with later(?) touches of green watercolor on laid paper, laid down on old mount
artworks.description: The image is shot from a slightly elevated point of view, showing various details in the surroundings. The horizon and sky with a few soft clouds are visible in the background. The style appears to be a pen drawing with fine line work creating texture on trees and the landscape. The color palette consists of shades of brown, giving the image an antique look. Two slender trees are visible in the foreground, with figures and animals in the middle ground. In the distance, the landscape rises and falls, with mountains blending into the horizon.

artworks.title: Young Man in a Soft Cap
artworks.medium: black chalk on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: overall: 29 × 20.5 cm (11 7/16 × 8 1/16 in.), sheet cut irregularly
artworks.description: The image depicts a person from the waist up, turned to the right. The person has their head slightly tilted forward, with their gaze directed downward. Their facial features are delicately sketched, showing a calm expression. Their hair is partially visible under a wrapped headscarf or turban. The person is wearing a flowing garment with soft, layered lines and a sash around the waist. The sketch is monochromatic, drawn on textured paper. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Standing Figure Wearing a Hat
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with gray wash on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a person depicted in a full-body sketch standing with a slight tilt, leaning slightly to the right. The face is obscured by a wide-brimmed hat. The individual is wearing formal attire, including a coat draped over the shoulders with intricate button details. The legs are covered with fitted trousers and shoes. The background is plain, focusing the viewer's attention on the figure.
